versions.content: Semantics of GlobalTimeMaster . isSystemWideGlobal- TimeMaster The attribute GlobalTimeMaster . isSystemWideGlobalTimeMas- ter indicates whether a given GlobalTimeMaster is considered an independent (i.e. [constr_1373] applies) source of global time information.
